podcast.title: Lou Reed's First Band with a Recording (1958)
podcast.body: The Shades were a Dubock group that Lou Reed was a part of in 1958 when he was 14 years old, marking his entry into the recording business. This high school band stood out by releasing a single, which included Lou's first recorded performance. "What made The Shades different was the fact that they recorded a single in 1958."

srcs.source: The Ongoing History of New Music
srcs.episode: The Book of World Records Version 1.0 - Part 2

podcast.title: Lou Reed's Earliest Band
podcast.body: The Shades was Lewis Allen Reed's (Lou Reed's) earliest band, and they focused on the Doo-wop genre popular at the time. "Lewis's earliest band was The Shades and they were into the duop of the day."

srcs.source: The Ongoing History of New Music

xref.title: First Recorded Moments (1958)
xref.body: At just 14 years old, Lou Reed made his first ever recorded moments in 1958 as a member of The Shades, a Dubock group. This early recording, "So Blue," marked the very beginning of a career that would later profoundly influence the alt-rock scene. "This was Lou's first ever recorded moments."

xref.title: Influence on Alt-Rock Icons
xref.body: Despite his humble beginnings with The Shades, Lou Reed later became a foundational influence on many significant artists in the alt-rock scene. His work inspired figures such as David Bowie, Iggy Pop, R.E.M., and The Killers. "he would later influence Bowie and Iggy and R.E.M. and the killers and so many of the other movers and shakers of the alt-rock scene in the decades ahead."

srcs.source: The Ongoing History of New Music
srcs.episode: The Book of World Records Version 1.0 - Part 2

xref.title: Longest-Serving Alt-Rock Musician
xref.body: Lou Reed is recognized as the longest surviving alt-rock new rock musician in the world, having continuously recorded and toured since 1958. His career has spanned over 50 years, starting with his time in The Shades. "He is the longest surviving alt-rock new rock musician in the world."
